english.title: Fail to give notice of intention to comply with local authority's notice to do work
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), failed to give to **(..SPECIFY LOCAL AUTHORITY..) at least

(A)_[48 hours' notice before complying with a requirement under section 82(1)(e) of the Building Act 1984 to **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT UNDER SECTION 82(1)(e)..)]_
(B)_[48 hours' notice before complying with a requirement under section 82(1)(f) of the Building Act 1984 to **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT UNDER SECTION 82(1)(f)..)]_
(C)_[24 hours' notice before complying with a requirement under section 82(1)(g) of the Building Act 1984 to **(..SPECIFY REQUIREMENT UNDER SECTION 82(1)(g)..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 82(3) of the Building Act 1984.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
failed to give notice to local authority
at least 24 hours if s 82(1)(g) applies /
at least 48 hours if s 82(1)(e) or (f) applies before complying with requirement
